title: Budget-aware experiment ramping for high-cost model variants
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Running A/B tests or canaries that include high-cost model variants (e.g., large-context or premium quantized models) can blow budget and delay iterations. We need a standardized playbook and automation for per-experiment budgets, dynamic traffic pacing, and automated rollback when spend or quality burn rates exceed thresholds.

Goal: Define the product-level orchestration and acceptance criteria so PM/Eng/Infra can ship an experiment gating primitive that: 1) enforces a token/compute budget per experiment, 2) gradually ramps traffic using cost-aware pacing, 3) exposes clear signals for rollback and emergency stop, and 4) integrates with Console dashboards and rollout APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Per-experiment budget (tokens or $) can be set at creation and enforced automatically by the platform
Ramping policy templates available: linear, exponential backoff, and 'budget-preserving' (pacing that respects remaining budget)
Automated stop/rollback triggers based on spend burn-rate, error-rate, latency regressions, or quality degradation metrics
Console shows live budget consumption, projected burn-through date, and per-model cost attribution
Experiment API returns explicit status (ACTIVE, PAUSED, STOPPED_DUE_TO_BUDGET) and reason codes
Runbooks and owner/alerting mappings exist for escalation when experiments hit thresholds
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Design and spec (2 sprints) — align on budget model, API surface, and Console UX
Phase 1: Prototype enforcement shim (ENG) — enforce budget at routing layer for a single model family
Phase 2: Expand policies and templates, integrate with Console metrics (observability)
Phase 3: Pilot with two internal experiments (grep: billing-heavy ranking use-case, paid feature spike), gather telemetry
Phase 4: Docs, runbooks, and public release in runtime-1.20 with sample SDK snippets
monitoring_signals: Per-model per-route latency and error-rate deltas vs baseline
Quality regression signals tied to eval prompt set (delta in accuracy/ROUGE/bleu where applicable)
Infrastructure backpressure (queue length, batch sizes, GPU utilization)
escalation_path: Primary: Experiment owner (PM) -> Infra on-call -> Runtime SRE -> Engineering manager. Pager threshold: unplanned >30% overspend within a 1-hour window or latency p50 regression >200ms for 15m. Alerts auto-annotate the experiment key and include a quick 'stop experiment' runbook link.
notes: Trade-offs: strict per-experiment budgeting can introduce early false-positive stops for small-sample noise; will include a short cool-down window before final stop
Consider exposing 'grace credits' for experiments that need occasional burst capacity (configurable, charged to experiment budget)
Integration thought: reuse existing rollout APIs and circuit-breaker hooks from PM-52013 to avoid duplicate plumbing
UX: show forecasted spend and suggested pacing profiles when creating experiment in Console
